writtenBy: lane 69-a (the deferred loop): one LIVE 24-turn refunder-region session, re-running the v2 accounting on live evidence — the promotion path 68-a-r2 left wired and waiting
corpus_law: LIVE session battery (the 67-c harness pattern, refunder-region focused): every turn is a customer refund moment routed through the v2 pipeline (router rule → extraction pre-step → factRequired gate → frozen lookup (empty at run time) → joint / routed-refusal). Facts are EXTRACTED from the message text by src/facts.js rules, never hand-assigned. Model calls ONLY where the soft joint actually rules (grounded facts, frozen-miss): exactly 8 turns (T02–T09). Fact-starved moments are REFUSED and routed to refunder.ask-receipt (free). T18 repeats T04 verbatim to exercise the in-session cache (free). Cohorts are a PRE-REGISTERED design (see eval/dryrun-69a.js + fleet-seeds seeds/preregister-69a.json): A = receipt-true + within-7 ×3 (expect full refund), B = receipt-false + within-7 ×3 (expect store credit), C = over-7 ×2 (expect manager review; n=2 is below threshold — emergent, watched, receipted), starved ×15 (ask-back), cache ×1. Whether the MODEL rules each region unanimously is the empirical question the freeze test answers on LIVE rows.
policy: full refund within 7 days with a receipt, store credit without, manager review after 7 days

budget.note: mission cap ≤8 external calls TOTAL; typesafe 0 = the classifier can never spend (router rules route every turn; a rule-miss would fail closed, receipted)
